note: Written by hand from the git history of the app and the server. Newest first. kind: new | better | fix. area: app | server.

releases.title: Training, a fuller profile, and safer names

items.text: Training: play against bots on your phone, with no turn timer
Profile: play style map, key numbers and a full statistics page
Pick the side margins yourself: 0, 4, 8, 12 or 16
Report a player, and block them so you don't see their reactions
Offensive names are refused, with look-alikes like f.u.c.k caught too
Admin dashboard with stats, moderation and problems
Bet picker as a list of hands, with the turn timer back under your hand
Stat cards explain themselves in a sheet from the bottom
The final check plays out before the winner is named
Old phone apps are asked to update
The header back button works again on iOS 26

releases.title: How to play, a new profile, and reactions

items.text: How to play: a guided tour with four practice hands
Quick reactions: send a phrase or an emoji to the table
New profile with stats, an emote picker and card decks
Super dark: an optional pure black dark mode
Experimental table view, and Advanced sections in the game menu
Fun names for new rooms and bots
Cards in your hand are sorted from low to high
Interface polish: 16 pt margins, an open seat, a clearer header
17 emoji and "Loser!" as reactions
A new look: theme, table view, bet picker and hand panel
Light theme, and a theme switch in the game menu
Join a room with a 6-letter code, a link or a QR code
New app icon and splash screen
Landing page at /home that explains the game
The host picks the card limit for the table
A rewritten game server that keeps games going on bad connections
The reveal is staged: matching cards lift and the winning cards light up
The name of the player whose turn it is grows
Two pair and full house are picked in two steps
A countdown shows when the next deal starts
The pause before the next deal is 10 seconds
The bet picker is off when it isn't your turn
Room links join once connected instead of saying unavailable
Feedback form errors show inside the form
Add bots to a room
Spectator mode: watch a game you're not in
Send a bug report with the app's logs
Shuffle the players before a game
Game instructions, in English and Polish
Links to the phone apps on the website
Share the app from the menu
Connection status, a turn timer and reconnecting
Turn timeout, heartbeat and reconnection for poor connections
Toasts tell you whose turn it is
Compact game view
Bots no longer stall after a deal or when someone is knocked out
Play Liar's Poker online with friends
Accounts, a profile with an avatar, and a list of rooms
Card animations and haptics
Dark mode, then a theme switch (Nov 2025)
Send feedback from the app (Nov 2025)
Online game server with rooms and a queue
